            reduction="none",

        target_losses = torch.nn.functional.softplus(

def sample_mining_pool(user_train, trace, itemnum, maxlen, rng):
    # Separate from all user, window, corruption and standard-negative streams.
    # Replacement permits a 32-entry pool even with one eligible catalog item.
    pool = np.zeros((len(trace), maxlen, 32), dtype=np.int64)
    seeds = []
    for row, source in enumerate(trace):
        excluded = set(user_train[source["user"]])
        if len(excluded) >= itemnum:
            raise RuntimeError("no eligible mining-pool item")
        row_seeds = []
        for position in source["selected"]:
            seed = rng.getrandbits(64)
            row_seeds.append(seed)
            target_rng = random.Random(seed)
            for column in range(32):
                candidate = target_rng.randint(1, itemnum)
                while candidate in excluded:
                    candidate = target_rng.randint(1, itemnum)
                pool[row, position, column] = candidate
        seeds.append(row_seeds)
    return pool, seeds


def bpr_sequence_loss(
    model: nn.Module,
    seq: torch.Tensor,
    pos: torch.Tensor,
    neg: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    epoch: int = 1,
    pool: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    capture: dict | None = None,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    if epoch < 1:
        raise ValueError("epoch must be one-based")
    if seq.ndim != 2 or pos.shape != seq.shape:
        raise ValueError("sequence and positives must have matching B x L shapes")
    valid = pos != 0
    if not bool(valid.any()):
        raise RuntimeError("masked-target batch has no supervised positions")
    if not bool((seq[valid] == model.mask_token).all()):
        raise RuntimeError("every supervised target must be hidden by MASK")
    if neg.ndim == 2:
        neg = neg.unsqueeze(-1)
    if neg.ndim != 3 or neg.shape[:2] != pos.shape or neg.shape[-1] < 1:
        raise ValueError("negatives must have shape B x L or B x L x K")
    targets, uniform = pos[valid], neg[valid]
    if not bool(((targets >= 1) & (targets <= model.itemnum)).all()):
        raise ValueError("positive target outside the real-item catalog")

    def check_negatives(items):
        if not bool(((items >= 1) & (items <= model.itemnum)).all()):
            raise ValueError("negative outside the real-item catalog")
        if bool((items == targets[:, None]).any()):
            raise ValueError("positive sampled as a negative")

    check_negatives(uniform)
    # One encoder forward: selection and loss share these stochastic features.
    features = model.log2feats(seq)[valid]
    negatives = uniform
    selection = None
    mining = NEGATIVE_POLICY == "curriculum" and epoch > 20
    if mining:
        if uniform.shape[1] != 16 or pool is None:
            raise ValueError("curriculum requires uniform16 and an independent pool32")
        if pool.shape != (*seq.shape, 32):
            raise ValueError("mining pool must have shape B x L x 32")
        pool_items = pool[valid]
        check_negatives(pool_items)
        with torch.no_grad():
            pool_scores = model.predict_score(features.detach(), pool_items)
            if pool_scores.shape != pool_items.shape:
                raise ValueError("incorrect mining score shape")
            if not bool(torch.isfinite(pool_scores).all()):
                raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite mining scores")
            order = torch.argsort(pool_scores, dim=1, descending=True, stable=True)
            ranks = torch.tensor([8, 12, 16, 20], device=seq.device)
            indices = order.index_select(1, ranks)
            chosen = pool_items.gather(1, indices)
        negatives = torch.cat((uniform[:, :12], chosen), dim=1)
        if capture is not None:
            selection = {
                "pool_ids": pool_items.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "pool_scores": pool_scores.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "selected_indices": indices.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "one_based_ranks": [9, 13, 17, 21],
            }

    positive_scores = model.predict_score(features, targets)
    negative_scores = model.predict_score(features, negatives)
    if positive_scores.shape != targets.shape or negative_scores.shape != negatives.shape:
        raise ValueError("incorrect candidate score shape")
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(positive_scores).all() & torch.isfinite(negative_scores).all()):
        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite candidate logits")
    if TRAIN_OBJECTIVE == "ce":
        logits = torch.cat((positive_scores[:, None], negative_scores), dim=1)
        target_losses = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
            logits,
            torch.zeros(len(targets), dtype=torch.long, device=seq.device),
            reduction="none",
        )
    else:
        target_losses = torch.nn.functional.softplus(
            negative_scores - positive_scores[:, None]
        ).mean(dim=1)
    loss = target_losses.mean()
    if capture is not None:
        effective = neg.detach().clone()
        effective[valid] = negatives.detach()
        sorted_ids = negatives.detach().sort(dim=1).values
        unique_counts = 1 + (sorted_ids[:, 1:] != sorted_ids[:, :-1]).sum(dim=1)
        capture.update(
            {
                "sequence": seq.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "positive": pos.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "uniform_negative": neg.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                "negative": effective.cpu().tolist(),
                "negative_provenance": "model_ranked_pool" if mining else "uniform",
                "selection": selection,
                "mean_unique_negatives": float(unique_counts.float().mean().item()),
                "loss": {
                    "positive_scores": positive_scores.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                    "negative_scores": negative_scores.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                    "selected_indices": valid.nonzero().detach().cpu().tolist(),
                    "target_losses": target_losses.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                    "actual_loss": float(loss.detach().item()),
                    "objective": TRAIN_OBJECTIVE,
                    "negative_reduction": "logsumexp" if TRAIN_OBJECTIVE == "ce" else "mean",
                    "reduction": "pooled_valid_target_mean",
                    "denominator": int(targets.numel()),
                    "auxiliary_loss": 0,
                    "regularization_in_scalar": 0,
                    "dtype": str(positive_scores.dtype),
                },
            }
        )
    return loss


class DiagnosticLoader:
    """Disposable fixed one-negative batches; never consumes a training iterator."""

    def __init__(self, user_train, itemnum, batch_size, maxlen, num_batches=10):
        self.user_train = user_train
        self.itemnum = itemnum
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.maxlen = maxlen
        self.num_batches = num_batches

    def __iter__(self):
        rngs = tuple(random.Random(SEED + p) for p in (5100, 5200, 5300))
        for _ in range(self.num_batches):
            sequence, positive, negative = sample_batch(
                self.user_train, self.itemnum, self.batch_size, self.maxlen,
                num_negatives=1, rngs=rngs,
            )
            yield (
                None,
                torch.from_numpy(sequence),
                torch.from_numpy(positive),
                torch.from_numpy(negative),
            )


def measure_fixed_diagnostic_margins(model, loader, device):
    # This consumes the supplied disposable loader and measures real masked targets.
    # It does not replace DiagnosisProbe or claim held-out validation coverage.
    was_training = model.training
    margins = []
    inspected = invalid = 0
    try:
        model.eval()
        with torch.inference_mode():
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in loader:
                sequence = sequence.to(device)
                positive = positive.to(device)
                negative = negative.to(device)
                selected = positive != 0
                valid = (
                    selected & (sequence == model.mask_token)
                    & (positive >= 1) & (positive <= model.itemnum)
                    & (negative >= 1) & (negative <= model.itemnum)
                )
                inspected += 1
                invalid += int((selected & ~valid).sum().item())
                if bool(valid.any()):
                    features = model.log2feats(sequence)[valid]
                    values = (
                        model.predict_score(features, positive[valid])
                        - model.predict_score(features, negative[valid])
                    )
                    if not bool(torch.isfinite(values).all()):
                        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite diagnostic margins")
                    margins.append(values.float().cpu())
    finally:
        model.train(was_training)
    values = torch.cat(margins) if margins else torch.empty(0)
    count = int(values.numel())
    return {
        "metrics": {
            "inspected_batches": inspected,
            "valid_targets": count,
            "invalid_targets": invalid,
            "pos_neg_margin_mean": float(values.mean()) if count else None,
            "pos_neg_margin_p10": (
                float(values.kthvalue(max(1, math.ceil(0.1 * count))).values)
                if count else None
            ),
            "pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate": float((values < 0).float().mean()) if count else None,
            "pos_neg_small_margin_rate": float((values < 0.5).float().mean()) if count else None,
        },
        "metric_definitions": {
            "inspected_batches": "Actually consumed independent seed-42 diagnostic batches",
            "valid_targets": "Real positive/negative labels at reserved-mask positions",
            "invalid_targets": "Selected labels failing the reserved-mask/catalog audit",
            "pos_neg_margin_mean": "Mean positive-minus-negative logit; training-exposed separation",
            "pos_neg_margin_p10": "Nearest-rank tenth percentile of measured training margins",
            "pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate": "Fraction of measured margins below zero",
            "pos_neg_small_margin_rate": "Fraction of measured margins below 0.5; depends on logit scale",
        },
        "exposure": "training-exposed; not host validation",
    }
